type_name.description: Type name, any letter case. Sized names: int8-int64, uint8-uint64, float32, float64 or double. Bare Python names: int = int64 and float = float64; in C, Arrow and Parquet float is 32-bit, so write float32 for those columns. Also str/string, bytes/binary, bool, decimal (with precision and scale), date and datetime/timestamp.
